scope: Astra Linux 1.7 x86-64 availability and build prerequisite check
blocker: Astra has glibc 2.28 and no C++/CMake/LLVM toolchain. The official LLVM 22.1.8 Linux x86-64 release is built against a newer glibc; building LLVM/MLIR 22 from source on 4 cores and 16G free is not a bounded acceptance step. No source transfer or compiler build was attempted.
